grh_30ec831ea4b4232f9578.title: Miniatures
paragraphs: Wealthy Matilda Winston controls her grandson Claude through his trust fund while devoting herself to a valuable collection of miniature objects and dolls. Claude discovers that dog groomer Anna has been stealing miniatures from wealthy clients and uses that secret when Matilda announces plans to leave her fortune to her dog and place Claude's reduced share in trust. He forces Anna to enter Matilda's house at a chosen time so she can be framed for murder, then kills Matilda hours earlier and later reports that he caught Anna fleeing after strangling her. His scheme initially fits Anna's record as a thief. But Dr. Hartness notices that Matilda's smashed miniature clock stopped at 2:10 and that her body is already cool near eight o'clock, evidence that directly contradicts Claude's story and begins to expose the frame-up.

grh_3089132aa262d7e99438.title: Hiram's Gold Strike
paragraphs: Old prospector Hiram brings another set of ore samples to the assayer, and this time several look promising enough to justify more tests. Before the assay can be settled, two robbers invade the office; Hiram resists and is badly shot while Britt brings the gunmen down. With Hiram losing the will to live, friends encourage him with the prospect that he has finally struck gold, and even his suspicion that they may be humoring him restores his determination to recover and prove himself. By the time he is well, the excitement around his claim has become a genuine gold rush and Hiram finally has more money than he knows what to do with.
